_readme: Hand fixes to client/src/locales/<lang>/sandboxPz.json that must survive a re-run of scripts/extract-pz-sandbox-ground-truth.mjs.

curatedLocales: the committed sandboxPz.json IS the source of truth for these locales. A re-run keeps every existing value, fills only keys the file lacks (PZ's translation if it ships one, else English) and drops keys the schema no longer has. Fix a curated locale by editing its file directly.

overrides: for PZ-sourced locales (values come from the game's own Sandbox.json), one entry per key where the game's text is wrong or unusable. 'value' is what we ship, 'pz' is the game text it replaces as of the last extraction, 'reason' says why. The extractor applies every override on each run, fails on an override whose key left the schema, and warns when the game text no longer matches 'pz' (the game may have fixed it -- re-check) or when the override has become redundant.
Do NOT add an override to paper over a wrong translation KEY: if a label is the text of some other setting, the key resolution is broken -- fix the extractor, don't mask it here.

curatedLocales.zh-TW: Taiwan-usage wording authored for the panel (453d5c89). PZ's CH file is the fill-in source for new keys only.
curatedLocales.uk: Authored translation (6ecf61c5). PZ's UA file is the fill-in source for new keys only.
curatedLocales.ht: Haitian Creole has no PZ translation; authored (4bedf517).
curatedLocales.ar: Arabic has no PZ translation (PZ's AR folder is Argentinian Spanish); authored (7f91f1b7).
